verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents several in-product AI features that draw on the user's own email. Instant Summaries appear at the top of threads, Ghostwriter offers autocomplete suggestions based on the user's previous emails, and the AI assistant can read threads, search the full email history and identify important emails and todos. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI insight and suggestion features; the community evidence predates them and does not discuss them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Instant Summaries show up at the very top of your email threads the instant you open them.
These AI suggestions are intelligent and based on previous emails you've written, so they sound just like you
it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more
Identify important emails & todos with a single click.
